chunks: May Allah bless Muhammad the Chosen One, Ali the one He is pleased with, Fatima the Radiant, and the Chosen Imams from her descendants, the Goodly Family of Ya Sin, the Righteous, and grant them much peace.

key_terms.آل يس: Al Yasin (Family of Ya Sin) — a title for the Prophet’s household, linked to Surah Ya Sin (36:1)
key_terms.الأبرار: Al-Abrar (the Righteous) — Quranic term denoting those who are pious and morally upright
key_terms.الزهراء: Az-Zahra (the Radiant/Luminous) — title of Fatima (AS), daughter of the Prophet
key_terms.المرتضى: Al-Murtada (the one God is pleased with) — title of Imam Ali (AS)
key_terms.المصطفى: Al-Mustafa (the Chosen One) — title of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW)

ai.seo_question: What is the salawat upon the Prophet’s family including Ali, Fatima, and the Imams?
ai.summary: This is a closing salawat (invocation of blessings) by Shaykh al-Saduq at the end of an assembly session in his Amali. It invokes God’s blessings and peace upon the Prophet Muhammad, Imam Ali, Fatima al-Zahra, and the Imams descended from her. The phrase "Family of Ya Sin" (Al Yasin) is a title for the Prophet’s household, referencing Surah Ya Sin (36:1), and "the Righteous" (al-Abrar) emphasizes their moral perfection.
word_analysis: the one He is pleased with
